scope: Root observations and scoring preparation, not independent scores or verified product finding dispositions.

notes.scope: Independent scoring after seven sequential arms, no actor score substitution
notes.paired: Code and data only; routing is only intended difference; installed procedure in both; no absent-skill causal inference.
notes.criteria: Apply every frozen check and applicable dimension; no null scores, no compensation. Execute independent checks not just read journal. Pass threshold 8.5 and zero errors.
notes.provenance: Actor journals are authored journals not raw native transcripts. Pairing enum transcript must explicitly qualify source type; combine outer spawn/lifecycle observer evidence. Effective model/effort, token and money null unless exposed. Actor calls/root dispatch-to-terminal interval limited operational not monetary measures; bounds include observation latency.
notes.immutability: Do not overwrite arm artifacts/journals/frozen inputs or previous evidence. Own fresh scoring directory. Hash immutable prompt/checks/inputs/installed against initial list; allowed state changes intentional. Browser profiles excluded from general content inspection.
notes.scenarios: Creative must view actual game screenshots both viewports and run actual keyboard sequences/timings; neutral setup probe insufficient. Recovery and promotion source fixtures synthetic labeled, not authentic historical runs. Promotion actual three distinct role actors.
notes.failures: Preserve all failed/untested evidence; no resetting holdout after seeing outcome. Product repairs source separate wave critic then informed diagnostic rerun qualification.
